errors.text_span: Die Linie für 2025 ist mittelblau und verläuft im ersten Jahresdrittel im Bereich um die 30- bis 40‑%‑Gitterlinien
errors.evidence: The line for 2025 does not run in the 30-40% range. It starts at approximately 78% in January and drops down into the 30-40% range by late March, at which point the line ends. The description incorrectly describes its path.

errors.text_span: und steigt danach bis in den Herbst in den Bereich oberhalb der 70‑%‑Gitterlinie
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates the trajectory of the 2025 line. The line for 2025 is only plotted for the first few months of the year (January to late March/early April) and does not exist in the second half of the year, so it cannot rise into autumn as claimed.

errors.text_span: Die „Speicherverpflichtung“ ist durch große blaue Quadrate markiert, darunter ein Quadrat bei „1. Feb“ auf Höhe der 30‑%‑Gitterlinie
errors.evidence: The description misidentifies the location of the blue squares representing 'Speicherverpflichtung'. The legend shows three squares, corresponding to Feb 1st (30%), Oct 1st (80%), and Nov 1st (90%). The description only mentions the one for Feb 1st, incorrectly implying there is only one, and then separately describes the other two squares as being located in the autumn without explicitly linking them to the 'Speicherverpflichtung' category.

errors.text_span: Die Linie für 2021 ist dunkelviolett; sie startet um die 70‑%‑Gitterlinie
errors.evidence: The 2021 line starts visibly higher than 70%, at approximately 75%.
